comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
Well, I sent in a ticket suggesting they restore this and the other tow permit skills from Oxford and was told, "We will check internally about the skills missing and consider what we can implement them in our server. We cannot promise this will occur anytime soon since this would take time to update, but you have been heard in this matter."

Maybe it'll be available in the future? Let's hope KOEI approves it. :)
